data.one_liner: Implement circular and polygon geofencing services with real-time status and location changes.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to set up circular or polygon geofence regions, listen to real-time status changes (enter, exit, dwell), and track location updates. It navigates location changes while the app is alive to provide more accurate geofencing.
use_when: You need to detect when a user enters, exits, or dwells within circular or polygon regions.
You require real-time location and geofence status updates.
You want to build custom geofencing logic for Android, iOS, or Web.
avoid_when: You rely strictly on battery-efficient native platform geofencing APIs, since this plugin navigates location while the app is alive.
You do not want to manage platform-specific location permissions.
strengths: Supports both circular and polygon geofence regions.
Provides real-time geofence status and location change listeners.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Battery efficiency cannot be guaranteed because it does not use native platform geofencing APIs.
Requires additional packages like flutter_foreground_task for background service implementation.
data.setup_notes: Requires location permissions declared in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist, and background mode settings if background tracking is needed.
